# ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve Azure subscription details directly from Azure via a CipherTrust Manager Azure connection. The subscriptions returned are fetched live from Azure and are not stored in the CipherTrust Manager database. Use ciphertrust_azure_subscription_list to query subscriptions already registered in CipherTrust Manager.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve all Azure subscriptions visible to the given connection.
# This queries Azure directly, not the CipherTrust Manager database.
# Use ciphertrust_azure_subscription_list to query subscriptions already
# added to CipherTrust Manager.

resource "ciphertrust_azure_connection" "connection" {
  name          = "azure-connection"
  client_id     = "your-client-id"
  tenant_id     = "your-tenant-id"
  client_secret = "your-client-secret"
  products      = ["cckm"]
}

data "ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details" "subs" {
  connection_id = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
}

# Output the Azure subscription ID of the first subscription found.
output "first_subscription_id" {
  value = data.ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details.subs.subscriptions[0].subscription_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) CipherTrust Manager Azure connection name or ID.

### Read-Only

- `subscriptions` (Attributes List) List of Azure subscriptions available to the connection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions))

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions`

Read-Only:

- `authorization_source` (String) The authorization source of the request.
- `display_name` (String) The subscription display name.
- `state` (String) The subscription state.
- `subscription_id` (String) The Azure subscription ID
- `subscription_policies` (Attributes) Subscription policies for this subscription. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscriptions--subscription_policies))
- `tenant_id` (String) The subscription tenant ID.

<a id="nestedatt--subscriptions--subscription_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscriptions.subscription_policies`

Read-Only:

- `location_placement_id` (String) The subscription location placement ID.
- `quota_id` (String) The subscription quota ID.
- `spending_limit` (String) The subscription spending limit.
